SELECT e.enterprise_id, e.com_acct_name, e.com_acct_code, COALESCE(m.role, 'MEMBER') AS role, COALESCE(m.status, 'ACTIVE') AS status FROM po_enterprise_info e LEFT JOIN tenant_user_membership m ON m.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN tenant_config creation ON creation.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND creation.params_code = 'PROVISION_REQUEST_ID' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT enterprise_id, MIN(joined_at) AS created_at FROM tenant_user_membership GROUP BY enterprise_id ) legacy_creation ON legacy_creation.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} OR e.enterprise_id = 1
ORDER BY COALESCE(creation.created_at, legacy_creation.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, e.enterprise_id DESC
